harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and verified inventory-worker on node1. It runs as inventorysvc inside a root-owned chroot where only /var/lib/inventory is writable. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 remain unchanged. The service and persistent data recovered after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the dedicated inventorysvc system account with a nologin shell.
Built a minimal root-owned chroot using existing OS binaries; no packages were installed.
Installed and enabled the inventory-worker systemd service with privilege and filesystem hardening.
Verified heartbeat operation, UID/GID, zero capabilities, chroot visibility, read-only root, and exclusive writable state directory.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed, service recovered, and persistent start count advanced from 1 to 2.

evidence.requirement: Run inventory-worker as dedicated unprivileged inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: Service is active and enabled; its process runs as UID/GID 996 with zero effective capabilities and NoNewPrivileges enabled.

evidence.requirement: Root-owned chroot with /var/lib/inventory as the only writable application directory
evidence.summary: Chroot directories are root-owned except /var/lib/inventory. Namespace evidence shows / mounted read-only and only the state directory mounted read-write; unprivileged write checks confirm the policy.

evidence.requirement: Healthy background worker and persistent application data
evidence.summary: Heartbeat advanced before and after reboot, the service remained active, and the persistent start counter advanced from 1 to 2.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre-change, pre-reboot, and post-reboot evidence consistently reports RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 9feeb0bb-6fe6-40fb-9831-d869ed07631c; the native delayed reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 943f0636-a778-4da2-a31b-b70f7467f0b0; service, confinement, heartbeat, and persistent data then recovered.
